title: neolepisorus fortuni
intro: Neolepisorus fortuni, commonly known as the Lepisorus fortuni, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has identified various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Neolepisorus fortuni are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiplatelet activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
